aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When section chief Liu Ben crosses paths with an eccentric colleague, he embarks on an unpredictable corporate journey that forces him to navigate workplace chaos and discover his true self-worth.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Liu Ben, a dedicated section chief at a branch of Zhonghe Group, finds his routine corporate life upended after meeting a standout colleague at a company event. Bound together by unexpected circumstances, the duo navigates a series of bizarre workplace challenges and office politics. Through comedy and conflict, Liu Ben begins to reevaluate his personal and professional goals. Ultimately, the chaotic journey helps him uncover his true self-worth beyond the traditional ladder of corporate success.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Liu Ben leads a quiet, predictable life as a mid-level section chief working at a regional branch of the massive Zhonghe Group. His mundane existence takes a dramatic turn following a large-scale company event where he encounters a uniquely memorable colleague who stands out from the corporate mold. Drawn into this dynamic coworker's orbit, Liu Ben is plunged into a series of highly unconventional workplace situations that disrupt his normal routine. Together, they are forced to tackle high-pressure projects, absurd administrative hurdles, and delicate interpersonal dynamics within the office. As trial after trial tests their resilience, Liu Ben finds himself questioning the rigid corporate culture he has long accepted without thought. The chaotic misadventures force him to step out of his comfort zone, leading to moments of profound personal reflection alongside lighthearted comedic mishaps. Along the way, the friendship forged between the two colleagues becomes a vital source of strength and mutual growth. By learning to embrace the unpredictability of his career and personal identity, Liu Ben ultimately redefines what success truly means to him.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set within the sprawling corporate world of Zhonghe Group, 'Make Zhonghe Great Again' follows Liu Ben, a relatable branch section chief navigating the modern workplace. After a chance meeting with a uniquely vibrant colleague during a company-wide gathering, Liu Ben's career takes a surprising detour. As the two team up to face an onslaught of quirky corporate hurdles and comedic office dilemmas, they build an unexpected bond that challenges their perspectives on ambition, loyalty, and self-value.
